thread:
jae: quick proposal: cap policy decision CPU time with a configurable decision-time budget and execute policy logic in small preemptible slots. reason: long policy evals are a major source of tail latency and risk SLA misses. initial take?

maria: sounds promising. how does this play with batching + KV cache?

jae: batching still happens at the serving layer. router needs to return a choice quickly; it can rely on KV/cache when present. the idea is the router will run policy eval for up to budget_ms; if it runs out, it returns the best-so-far via a fast-path fallback policy.

devon: budget per-tenant? per-route? global?
jae: defaults: global 20ms. enterprise tenants can override up to 50ms. also adaptive: if historical p95 > budget for tenant, increase window gradually.

sam: tradeoff: more decision time can save model token cost (pick cheaper model) but increases request latency. need concrete numbers.
jae: propose we add decision_cost_threshold too: runtime estimates potential token-cost savings; abort if time > budget AND estimated_savings < threshold.

maria: can you show config example?

jae: snippet: router:
  decision_time_budget_ms: "20"
  fallback_policy: "quick-route"
  adaptive_window: "true"
  slot_size_ms: "5"
  decision_cost_threshold_usd_per_100k: "0.50"

devon: what is slotting?
jae: run policy evaluators cooperatively in micro-slots. evaluators yield at slot boundaries so heavy matchers can be paused/resumed. if budget hits, we use best-so-far scoring. reduces tail work.

sam: test plan? last thing we want is silent routing regressions.
jae: build a replay sim: for each production trace run (1) full-policy baseline, (2) budgeted policy. compute metrics: route-divergence-rate, cost delta, latency delta, SLO violations.

maria: telemetry we need: per-decision latency histograms, fallback_rate, best_so_far_score_at_abort, tenant_adaptive_window_history.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-4612: "Decision-time-budget simulation harness + telemetry" assigned to devon.

devon: I'll own sim and replay infra. estimate two sprints for initial metrics and dashboards.

infra-bot: CI:policy-e2e queued for branch jae/decision-budget (job 4821).

sam: rollout: feature-flagged shadow mode (compute but don't enforce), kibana dashboards, then soft-fallback enabled for low-tier tenants, then widen. monitor regressions.
maria: add safety valve: if cluster-wide fallback_rate > 3% for 10m auto-disable budgeted path and page SRE.

jae: add tenant opt-out flag for deterministic routing customers. also add circuit-breaker metric and auto-rollback.

devon: cardinality concern: aggregate metrics by tenant_hash + tier label not raw tenant_id.

sam: offline tuning: run longer decision windows offline to compute "regret" distribution for candidate budgets and to choose decision_cost_thresholds.

jae: agreed. sim should produce per-tenant regret curves so product can set sensible defaults.

maria: follow-up items: devon+jae prototype slotting API + sim harness, sam drafts SLA/cost tradeoff doc, I'll draft rollout checklist and alerts.

devon: adding to sprint and pairing with jae on API design.

jae: RFC follow-up incoming with API sketches, example logs, and telemetry fields. thanks all.
